docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,437.50 FILED BY EARLE, CHRISLYN AS TO DEFENDANT HALL, TEIERAH ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-01-2019 AT 06:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF EARLE, CHRISLYN AS TO DEFENDANT HALL, TEIERAH
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF PER U.S. POSTAL SERVICE, "UNCLAIMED - RETURN TO SENDER - UNABLE TO FORWARD." COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED UNSERVED AS TO DEFENDANT HALL, TEIERAH

REMARK: PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED UNSERVED(FOR COURT DATE - JULY 1, 2019 ) AS TO: DEFENDANT - TEIERAH HALL; (ENVELOPE MARKED:RETURNED TO SENDER - UNCLAIMED - UNABLE TO FORWARD)
ORDER RE: CONTINUACE FOR PROOF OF SERVICE. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-01-2019 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO AUG-05-2019 AT 5:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF CHRISLYN EARLE IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT TEIERAH HALL IS NOT PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: MICHAEL MAU; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(506)
THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE: A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(506)
FILE DESTROYED PER ORDER SIGNED BY JUDGE SAMUEL FENG ON 10/11/2022 PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 681.53.
